utility_book.rationale: Finite industrial/utility book-value screen on reported common BVPS; reuse the Batch 16 industrial band, not a grid or water-company intrinsic model.

cyclical_book.rationale: Finite filing-review P/B screen on reported common BVPS; reuse the Batch 16 review band for operating-cycle and claim uncertainty.

layered_book.rationale: Finite layered-asset P/B screen; reuse the Batch 16 holding-company band without implying an appraised NAV or completed SOTP.

operating_earnings.rationale: Reuse the finite Batch 16 operating P/E screen for positive aligned TTM basic EPS; not a peer study or intrinsic property valuation.

logistics_sales.rationale: Finite low-multiple sales screen for a thin-margin logistics operator; not a peer-calibrated target or an equity cash-flow bridge.
